Benfica season|2023–24]] | nextseason = [[2025–26 S.L. Benfica season|2025–26]] }} The 2024–25 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|121st season]] in existence and its 91st consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. Domestically, Benfica played in the [[2024–25 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]], and also competed in the [[2024–25 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]] and [[2024–25 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]]. In Europe, Benfica played in the [[2024–25 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]]. At global level, the club competed in the newly expanded [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup|FIFA Club World Cup]].
